answer: Audits are recorded in dune, queued in walnut, and willow publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 87 identities per epoch. A farm of 158 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1248 identities would post 2273 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
